Ruling: model error; f4952 p. 3, Who Must File: "you must file Form 4952 to claim a deduction for your investment interest expense. Exception. You don't have to file Form 4952 if all of the following apply." The reply's note says the Schedule D pages do not say when Form 4952 is filed and reads it as filed whenever the filer has investment interest (f4952.has_interest); the project reads f4952.required (Form 4952 used, an election on line 4g or interest paid or carried forward, and the filing test with its exception). The reply is true where the exception applies and the form is not filed (classm.sd.2.deepseek: project false, reply true). The reply was not given the Form 4952 pages that decide it (an interface gap of the review), but its reading contradicts the source. Ruling: model error; f1040sd p. 1, line 13, "Capital gain distributions. See the instructions"; i1040sd p. 11, Line 13, "See Capital Gain Distributions"; f1099div box 2a. The amount is box 2a, asked when the taxpayer or spouse received dividends or other distributions (the parent question div.any). The candidate gates the amount on div.has_capital_gain, which the project defines as sd.distributions_if_dividends > 0 (forms/2025/div.yaml), so the candidate line reads itself: triage reports "cycle at sd.distributions_if_dividends" on every comparison it does not trivially pass. executable-triage-v2 (`.transcription/triage/2025/sd.json`, pass da3c033dcfd8; 1,986 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 40 partial bases, 392 partial records): 32 of 2,878 comparisons agree; kinds {"candidate-unknown": 2846}; by return {"completed": {"candidate-unknown": 1017}, "incomplete": {"candidate-unknown": 631}, "refused": {"candidate-unknown": 1198}}; completed witnesses (all candidate-unknown, project $0.00): stage14.asset.hy_5yr, mq_7yr, mq_mixed, mq_not, bonus_100, bonus_40_before. The line-scoped prompt listed div.has_capital_gain as a derived gate without its definition (tooling observation in the lane note), but div.any, the actual parent question, was offered; a gate on 'there are capital gain distributions' cannot decide the distribution amount.
